rules.text: Use the listed developer-facing outbound tag forms exactly. The IVR and keypad navigation forms are outbound only.
rules.why: The engine recognises particular markers in the reply and dispatches the matching action. A different label has no action handler.

rules.text: The engine uses the explicit TRANSFER destination first. An empty destination falls back to the shared agent transfer_number. Invalid or self targets are refused before dialling.
rules.why: Routing resolves one business number and validates one destination before starting the transfer.

rules.text: Use WAIT for an instructed pause while a person steps away. In an automated menu use IVR, PRESS with the actual keys, then IVR_END when a person speaks. Voicemail detection has a separate engine-owned marker.
rules.why: Human pauses, menu navigation and voicemail use separate call controls.

rules.text: The engine fills these outbound variables. Use their exact names inside double braces. The engine writes these values after merging recipient variables.
rules.why: The call supplies identity, direction and time context for each recipient.

rules.text: Outbound uses its call purpose for developer instructions. Inbound combines the shared agent instructions with the dialled number’s profile. Engine rules and eligible knowledge can also apply.
Send prompt for the single call. For a campaign use its prompt or the recipient’s prompt_override.

Choose case-sensitive ASCII letters, digits and underscores, for example {{appointment_time}}. Use dynamic_vars on a single call and map CSV columns to recipients[].variables for each campaign row. Supply caller_name and business_name yourself when referenced. Validate every row before submitting.
Enable incall_sms_enabled on the agent to use SEND_SMS. The business number on the call sends to the person being called.
Developers cannot add or rename an action tag.
rules.instead: Use the supported tag. For a custom integration, configure a custom function on the number and have the agent use the tool.

rules.text: caller_history is not automatically populated on outbound. caller_name and business_name are not engine-filled outbound variables either.
rules.instead: Supply the recipient facts you actually need in dynamic_vars or the batch row’s variables.

rules.text: Provide a meaningful call purpose meeting the minimum trimmed character count below. The HTTP route rejects blank input. Shorter nonblank input can trigger the no-purpose apology and ending instruction.
Start a single outbound call with agent_id, to_number and prompt. On a shared agent always specify the tenant’s owned from_number.
Create a voice campaign with recipients and their variables.

With required voice-detail validation enabled, absent, null or blank custom values produce 409 missing_voice_details before dispatch. Read details.missing, fill the named fields and submit the corrected request.
With that validation enabled, spaces or punctuation in a placeholder produce 409 unsupported_voice_placeholder. Rename it in the template and the recipient data.
Placeholder names must match the whole case-sensitive ASCII word pattern in the template and the supplied data.
